description: Credit-weighted CGPA (or SGPA/GPA) from a list of courses with credits and grade points: CGPA = Σ(credits × grade point) ÷ Σ credits. Use when the student gives per-course credits and grade points.

scale_max.description: Grading scale maximum, e.g. 10 for Indian universities, 4 for US GPA. Default 10.

name: calculate_cgpa
title: Calculate CGPA from courses
